observations.why: Directive cadence imposed by the speaker's rank: rehearsals will run monthly because the position-holder says so.

evidence.quote: we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: The 'we' is collective but the framing is a leader's definitional gate — an unrehearsed rollback is declared not to exist, enacting authority through assertion rather than command.
Cadence specification restated as a structural parameter the position-holder sets; same authority-ranking move as src-1, compressed to a label.
Self-designation as owner enacts rank-based allocation — the speaker claims the authority role by naming it.
